_doc: Slot registry for the five page templates. A content file (output/**.md, frontmatter `template: <name>`) is split on its `## ` headings; each heading is matched case-insensitively against a slot's `headings` (exact, or as a prefix followed by ':' / ' —' / ' -'). Unmatched headings land in the `body` slot as their own sections. Text between the H1 and the first ## becomes the lead when no lead heading exists. Rendered by resources/skills/workflow-ops/reading-pages/scripts/page.py. Change the look in theme.css and the *.html skeletons; never in content.

briefing.label: Briefing
briefing.use_for: daily intel, morning briefing, frontier digest, daily report, weekly review: dated, scannable, many short items

report.label: Research report
report.use_for: deep research, market/competitor teardown, diagnostic, podcast/source summary, any long read that answers a question

decision.label: Decision memo
decision.use_for: position paper, recommendation, architecture/vendor options, proposal challenge, go/no-go: one call with options

plan.label: Plan
plan.use_for: 90-day plan, playbook, roadmap, onboarding, training plan, campaign: phases with steps, owners and dates

slots.name: risks
headings: the one thing that would change all of this

dossier.label: Brief
dossier.use_for: person dossier, company/challenger brief, meeting prep, interview pack, cheat sheet, client leave-behind: one subject, read before you walk in
